title: Digital superhighways to sustainability: the impact of large-scale digital infrastructure construction on firms’ energy efficiency
title_zh: 数字高速公路通向可持续发展：大规模数字基础设施建设对企业能源效率的影响
authors: Lei Jiang, Yutong Niu, Kexin Chen, Qingyang Wu, Jinxing Guo, Jiali He
abstract: The ‘Broadband China’ policy, a series of digital infrastructure modernization projects starting in 2014, greatly expanded and improved local Internet access. This study utilizes the 2011–2016 firm-level data in a staggered difference-in-differences model to examine the energy efficiency gain from the policy. The findings show that the policy-covered enterprises reduced their energy intensity by 2.34% more than their uncovered counterparts, comprising 11.2% of the total Five-Year-Plan target in the sample period. This effect was more pronounced among firms in manufacturing, in eastern and central regions, in non-resource-based cities and among non-state-owned or large-scale firms. Mechanism analysis indicates that the policy reduces energy consumption and emissions by enhancing managerial efficiency and stimulating green innovation. This study shows that digital infrastructure promotes firms’ low-carbon transitions and also advances corporate social responsibility and sustainable development.
abstract_zh: 宽带中国”政策是自2014年起实施的一系列数字基础设施现代化项目，显著扩大并改善了地方互联网接入。本研究利用2011-2016年企业层面数据，采用交错双重差分模型，考察该政策带来的能效提升效应。研究发现，受政策覆盖的企业能源强度比未覆盖企业多降低2.34%，占样本期内整个五年计划目标的11.2%。这一效应在制造业企业、东部和中部地区、非资源型城市以及非国有或大型企业中更为显著。机制分析表明，该政策通过提升管理效率和激发绿色创新来降低能源消耗与排放。本研究显示，数字基础设施不仅推动企业低碳转型，还促进了企业社会责任与可持续发展。

title: Do Universal Free School Meals Improve the Dietary Quality of Food‐At‐Home Purchases?
title_zh: 全民免费校餐能否改善家庭食品购买的膳食质量？
authors: Xueying Ma, Andres Cuadros‐Meñaca, Michael R. Thomsen
abstract: Since 2014, the number of schools offering universal free meals to all enrolled children without requiring annual meal applications has increased meaningfully. Using USDA's Purchase to Plate Crosswalk, a difference‐in‐differences framework, and a nationwide consumer panel, the effect of universal‐free‐meal exposure on the diet quality of food‐at‐home purchases is assessed in terms of the Healthy Eating Index (HEI). Consistent with earlier findings, households exposed to universal free meals reduce grocery spending by over 6%. There is no deleterious overall effect of universal‐free‐meal exposure on the diet quality of food‐at‐home purchases as measured by the HEI.
abstract_zh: 摘要 自2014年以来，无需年度餐食申请即可向所有在校儿童提供免费餐食的学校数量显著增加。本研究利用美国农业部的"从采购到餐盘"数据转换工具、双重差分框架以及全国消费者面板数据，以健康饮食指数（HEI）为衡量标准，评估了普及免费餐食政策对家庭食品购买中居家饮食质量的影响。与早期研究结果一致，受普及免费餐食政策影响的家庭，其食品杂货支出减少了6%以上。以HEI为衡量指标，普及免费餐食政策对居家食品购买的整体饮食质量并未产生不利影响。

title: Do Not Drain The Swamp! Populism, Bureaucracy and Economic Performance
title_zh: 不要抽干沼泽！民粹主义、官僚主义与经济绩效
authors: Massimo Morelli, Dmitrii Petrukhin, Matia Vannoni, Massimo Morelli; Dmitrii Petrukhin; Matia Vannoni
official: 官方在线 2026-06-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Populist leaders often campaign against bureaucratic constraints, yet their economic performance may depend on the very institutional environment they inherit. We examine whether bureaucracy moderates the economic costs of populism using two complementary settings: cross-country synthetic-control evidence and a U.S. state-year panel spanning 1929–2023. The cross-country analysis offers suggestive evidence that the output decline following populist takeovers is attenuated in countries with stronger pre-existing bureaucratic institutions, particularly where bureaucracies are more independent. The U.S. state analysis provides sharper, within-country evidence. Leveraging LLM estimates of guberna-torial populism derived from State of the State speeches, we find that populist governors are associated with significantly lower per-capita income in states lacking an independent civil service, while no comparable penalty emerges—and the association is more than off-set—where such protections are in force. Heterogeneity-robust event-study estimates point in the same direction, with the post-entry income decline concentrated in states without civil-service reform. Together, the evidence is consistent with independent bureaucracies acting as a partial buffer against the economic costs of populist governance: the ”swamp” appears to dampen the damage populism would otherwise cause.
abstract_zh: 民粹主义领导人常以反对官僚体制束缚为竞选纲领，但其经济表现可能取决于所继承的制度环境。本文通过两个互补性研究设计——跨国合成控制证据与覆盖1929-2023年的美国州级面板数据——考察官僚体制是否调节了民粹主义的经济成本。跨国分析提供初步证据表明，在既有官僚制度更健全的国家（尤其是官僚机构独立性更强的国家），民粹主义执政后的产出下降幅度有所缓和。美国州级分析则提供了更精确的国内证据。通过利用大语言模型对州情咨文中州长民粹主义倾向的估算，本研究发现：在缺乏独立公务员制度的州，民粹主义州长与人均收入显著下降相关；而在实施公务员保护制度的州，不仅未出现类似的经济惩罚效应，其关联性甚至被完全抵消。异质性稳健的事件研究估计指向相同结论——民粹主义执政后的收入下降集中在未实施公务员制度改革的州。综合证据表明，独立官僚机构可作为缓冲机制部分抵消民粹主义治理的经济成本：所谓"沼泽"反而抑制了民粹主义本可能造成的损害。

title: How Efficient was the Affordable Care Act at Reducing Uninsured Rates?
title_zh: 《平价医疗法案在降低未参保率方面的效率如何？》
authors: Gangopadhyaya, Anuj, Kaestner, Robert, Kaestner, Robert John
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: One way to measure the efficiency of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) is the extent to which gains in publicly supported health insurance reduced uninsured rates. Using data from the 2008–2024 American Community Survey, we examine time trends in rates of uninsured, public insurance coverage, and employer-sponsored insurance (ESI) by groups defined by the ratio of income to the Federal Poverty Line (FPL). We obtain estimates of associations between changes in public coverage and changes in uninsured and ESI exploiting state-by-year variation in ACA implementation. Importantly, we estimate the total effect of the ACA—including both the Medicaid expansion and Marketplace coverage—on uninsured and ESI rates. For adults in households below 150% of the federal poverty level (FPL), increases in public insurance coverage were associated with one-for-one decrease in uninsured and no change in ESI. For adults with incomes between 151%–400% FPL, each percentage point increase in public coverage was associated with about a 0.6 percentage point decrease in uninsured and a 0.4 decrease, or crowd out, in ESI. Crowd-out was larger among groups with higher pre-ACA ESI rates such as parents and married adults. Using variation from the Medicaid expansion alone to evaluate the ACA’s effect on ESI leads to overstating crowd-out among low-income adults (below 150% FPL) and understating crowd-out among higher-income adults (above 250% FPL). Our findings suggest that policies intended to subsidize health insurance of higher income groups, for example, the enhanced premium subsidies, are far less efficient than policies intended to further expand public insurance to low-income groups, for example, in non-expansion states.
abstract_zh: 衡量《平价医疗法案》（ACA）效率的一个指标是公共资助医疗保险的覆盖增长在多大程度上降低了无保险率。利用2008-2024年美国社区调查数据，我们按收入与联邦贫困线（FPL）之比划分群体，考察了无保险率、公共保险覆盖率及雇主提供保险（ESI）的时间趋势。通过利用各州在ACA实施中的年度差异，我们估算了公共保险覆盖率变化与无保险率及ESI变化之间的关联。重要的是，我们评估了ACA（包括医疗补助扩展和市场保险覆盖）对无保险率和ESI的总体效应。对于家庭收入低于联邦贫困线150%的成年人，公共保险覆盖率的增加与无保险率的一对一降低相关，而ESI未发生变化。对于收入在联邦贫困线151%-400%之间的成年人，公共保险覆盖率每增加一个百分点，无保险率约下降0.6个百分点，ESI则下降0.4个百分点（即挤出效应）。在ACA实施前ESI率较高的群体（如父母和已婚成年人）中，挤出效应更为显著。仅利用医疗补助扩展的变异来评估ACA对ESI的影响，会导致对低收入成年人（低于150% FPL）的挤出效应被高估，而对高收入成年人（高于250% FPL）的挤出效应被低估。我们的研究结果表明，旨在补贴高收入群体医疗保险的政策（如增强型保费补贴）远不如旨在进一步向低收入群体扩展公共保险的政策（如在非扩展州）有效。

title: Fathers but not caregivers
authors: Aldén, Lina, Boschini, Anne, Tallås Ahlzén, Malin
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Fathers’ parental leave uptake remains low in many advanced economies despite substantial policy efforts. We study a setting where financial and eligibility barriers are minimal: employed, native-born first-time fathers entitled to generous, non-transferable leave benefits. Using Swedish population register data for 1995–2015, we document three key facts: (i) low uptake follows a persistent U-shaped income gradient, (ii) its determinants vary across the distribution—economic constraints at the bottom and top, workplace norms in the middle—and (iii) these constraints have grown more salient over time. Quota reforms increased uptake on average but did not narrow differences in low uptake between constrained and unconstrained fathers. Using quasi-random sibling-sex composition, we show that exposure to traditional gender-role environments increases the likelihood of low uptake in recent cohorts. The results highlight the limits of financial incentives and point to workplace and household norms as central barriers to equal parental leave participation.

title: Perizinan Berusaha dalam Perspektif Hukum Administrasi Negara dan Ekonomi
title_zh: 商业许可在国家行政法与经济学视角下的研究
authors: Zulfikar Ali, Intan Meitasari, Yuniwati Yuniwati
abstract: This study examines the role of State Administrative Law in promoting efficiency in the economic sector and social welfare through business licensing regulations. This issue is important because business licensing is not only an instrument of government control but also influences business actor behavior, transaction costs, legal certainty, and market competitiveness. The purpose of this study is to analyze government authority in terms of business licensing regulations and assess the extent of its influence on economic efficiency and public welfare. This study uses a normative juridical method with a statutory regulatory approach and a conceptual approach. Data were collected through a literature review of statutory regulations, state administrative law literature, and legal and economic studies. The analysis was conducted qualitatively by examining the relationship between administrative authority, licensing services, business actor compliance, and their impact on economic activity. The results of this study indicate that simple, transparent, and accountable business licensing can reduce bureaucratic barriers, increase compliance, and create certainty for business actors. Thus, State Administrative Law contributes significantly to building efficient, fair, and social welfare-oriented economic governance.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨国家行政法在通过商业许可法规促进经济部门效率与社会福利中的作用。该议题的重要性在于，商业许可不仅是政府管控的工具，更影响商业行为主体的决策、交易成本、法律确定性及市场竞争力。本研究旨在分析政府在商业许可法规中的行政权限，并评估其对经济效率与公共福利的影响程度。采用规范性法学研究方法，结合成文法路径与概念分析路径。通过文献综述收集成文法规定、国家行政法文献及法律经济学研究资料，运用定性分析方法考察行政权限、许可服务、商业主体合规性及其对经济活动影响的关联性。研究结果表明，简化、透明且可问责的商业许可制度能够降低官僚壁垒、提升合规水平，并为商业主体创造确定性。因此，国家行政法在构建高效、公平且以社会福利为导向的经济治理体系中发挥着关键作用。
